context: Stopped before any model context because priority verification failed; later attempt completed separately.

detector_parameters_preserved_verbatim.input: retained measured Fp1 only; no hidden targets or predictions
detector_parameters_preserved_verbatim.filter: second-order Butterworth 0.5-8 Hz, forward/backward independently per block
detector_parameters_preserved_verbatim.half_prominence_width: recorded, not used to select events

record.inclusion_policy: Primary full comparison retains every original eligible sample; no category is an exclusion.
record.empty_or_short_stratum_policy: Report sample count and NOT_ESTIMABLE when required statistics lack support; never replace intervals or change thresholds.
record.spectral_policy: Only complete, contiguous within-block Welch windows wholly inside the descriptive mask; never concatenate disjoint mask pieces. Record usable windows/coverage.
limitations: The proxy was computed on historical preparation, which had a demonstrated boundary artifact; frozen labels are imperfect historical categories, not corrected-input blink detection.
Proxy-untouched and outside-local-proxy do not mean artifact-free or clean neural ground truth.
All proxy parameters, events and masks are reused, not retuned using corrected model output.
Early means relative seconds [5,20); later means [20, original eligible endpoint], including original eligible samples slightly beyond nominal second55.
The older audit late_20_55 denominator was slightly shorter; this plan explicitly uses the full original eligible late interval and recounts only already-frozen event indices.
Event rates within proxy-conditioned categories are mathematically conditioned by their definition; not estimates of physiological blink prevalence.
Counts/256 are sample-equivalent durations on the model grid, not claims of independently verified physical timing.
Forty-five overlapping descriptive intersections are not independent replications or multiplicity-adjusted hypothesis tests; no p-values or outcome-based exclusions.
No original report, recipe, recording, installed application or previous evaluation score is changed.
